title: ChatGPT Image 2.0 will change design forever #shorts
description:
OpenAI just launched ChatGPT Images 2.0.

And this can do two insane things with visuals we have never seen before.

First, perfect text.

This thing can generate infographics, slides, restaurant menus, and carousels.

Perfect user interfaces down to the pixel.

Any font you want, all languages, perfectly.

But the text generation is honestly the less impressive of the two innovations.

Cause the thing that really blew me away is the Visual Intelligence.

This is the first ever image model that can both think and generate visuals at the same time.

Here’s why that’s so huge.

They asked it to generate an infographic showing the latest products from OpenAI’s merch drop.

In the past, AI image models would just guess what merch meant.

They’d pick random colors, generic designs…

That’s why you get the whack images with the weird cyrillic looking text.

But this model is way different.

It first goes and figures out contextually what you’re talking about.

It finds the merch store, looks up the products, sees the images, finds the prices…and then comes back and generates a flawless infographic with brand colors, accurate prices and perfect text.

Think about what that means….

If you run a brand, you could just say…make me a luxury vintage aesthetic visual campaign about my newest collection.

And without you holding its hand, it can go and find all the information it needs to then make those visuals accurately.

This is available now inside of OpenAI.

And I’m telling you, this is a big one.
